title: Bijan Robinson's $75M extension with Falcons resets market and our beliefs on value of running backs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bijan Robinson's $75M extension with Falcons resets market and our beliefs on value of running backs
sources.description: Contract negotiations involving Robinson, 24, and Jahmyr Gibbs, 24, challenge the often-repeated premise that it's unwise to invest significant money or draft capital in the running back position.
